summary: 69-year-old man fell ~70 feet to the ground while climbing the Chockstone Route in Eldorado Canyon State Park with his partner; bystanders and rescuers performed CPR after his heart stopped; 911 call just before 2:20 p.m. Sunday; ~2-hour stretcher carry down rocky terrain to an ambulance; hospitalized with life-threatening injuries.
location: Chockstone Route, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Eldorado Canyon State Park staff; Mountain View Fire Protection District
notes: Denver Post via EMS1; heart stopped, resuscitated with CPR; survived per headline. Date triangulated: article says rescue was Sunday afternoon; search-index crawl age ~309 days before 2026-09-14 = 2025-11-09, which was a Sunday; page footer (c)2025.
